An '''armored battlegroup''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
An armored [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] was comprised of two [[armor regiment]]s, two [[Vanguard armor regiment/Legends|vanguard armor regiments]], and [[battlegroup headquarters]]. It included 16,346 personnel, 1,132 [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]], and 318 [[Tank|heavy tanks]]. Armored battlegroups were deployed when the enemy had considerable strength.<ref name="ISB" />

Armored battlegroups could be augmented by the addition of four more [[armor regiment]]s.<ref name="ISB2" />
